subject.title: refactor(ui): direct enable/disable and remove actions on plugin cards

question: Should MCP server removal remain an immediate one-click action on every row, or require confirmation like plugin uninstall?
rationale: Both implementations are mechanically straightforward, but the acceptable safety posture for deleting persisted MCP configuration is a Control UI product decision rather than a correctness question automation can settle.

options.title: Confirm MCP removal
options.body: Add the existing inline confirmation pattern before deleting an MCP server, preserving the direct button while reducing accidental configuration loss.

options.title: Accept immediate removal
options.body: Land the one-click trash action as an intentional expert-oriented interaction and explicitly accept the increased accidental-removal risk.

recommendation.title: Confirm MCP removal
recommendation.body: Add the existing inline confirmation pattern before deleting an MCP server, preserving the direct button while reducing accidental configuration loss.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent merged Control UI history and the strongest available context for the intended Plugins-page interaction.
